name: SliderComponent
description: Set of fields of FormItemControl component

inputs.name: ariaLabelledBy
inputs.description: ID of the element that labels slider.

inputs.name: ariaValueText
inputs.description:
aria-valuetext for the slider
provides a human-readable text alternative for a slider's current numeric value.
Assistive technologies usually announce the numeric value stored in aria-valuenow.
When a bare number is not meaningful or needs context, aria-valuetext overrides the numeric announcement with a descriptive string.

inputs.name: customValues
inputs.description: Array of custom values to use for Slider.

inputs.name: hideProgressBar
inputs.description: Hides display of colored progress bar.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description:
Slider mode.
Options include: 'single' | 'range'
The default is set to 'single'

inputs.name: showTicks
inputs.description: Toggles the visibility of tick marks.

inputs.name: showTicksLabels
inputs.description: Toggles the visibility of tick mark labels. Must be used in conjunction with 'showTicks'

inputs.name: tooltipMode
inputs.description: Tooltip can be two types, 'readonly' to display value and 'editable' to make the ability to set and display value.

inputs.name: vertical
inputs.description: Whether slider should have vertical alignment.
